verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair question for an online filing service, which could offer scheduled or auto-recurring filings, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual web filing (the Annual Report Wizard), plus an electronic annual-report reminder and GovDelivery subscriptions. Those are notifications, an adjacent feature rather than user-configurable background automation. Probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and filings sit behind an authenticated portal.
